messages.subject: DataTable rows displayed through tabsetPanel
parts:
Hi,

I would like to use a DataTable to display a data set with many columns. Because the many columns would take too much space and I would not want the user to have to scroll horizontally, a sensible solution for me is to group columns by related content and group them using a tabset. Under each tab only a limited number of columns of the DataTable is displayed. An easy solution is to render a different DataTable widget on each tab but then I would need that if rows are reordered in one tab, they appear on that order when the user clicks on another tab, so that the user is seeing different columns of the same rows. I have been searching for examples of such functionality and have not been able to find any.

I would be very happy to hear your suggestions about how to address this or if there are example out there that I have missed.

Thank you!!!

robert.

messages.subject: Re: DataTable rows displayed through tabsetPanel
parts:
I'm not sure if clicking tabs is really better than scrolling. Anyway,
I don't think it possible to achieve that in shiny. You may consider
the FixedColumns extension, though. See the DT website for examples:
http://rstudio.github.io/DT/extensions.html

Regards,
Yihui

messages.subject: Re: DataTable rows displayed through tabsetPanel
parts:
hi Yihui,

actually I realize I prefer not to use DT until it is in CRAN, b/c of complications depending on a non-CRAN package.

however, i have made some progress with the classical dataTable, i think i'm close to the solution and i wanted to show you the approach in case you have some suggestion. i'm retrieving the current page for each tab via a callback function, so the only thing left would be how to tell renderDataTable() to show the dataTable at a specific page, here is a minimal example in which in one tab i show the first two columns of the iris data set and in a second tab the next three columns. at the bottom of each tab the current page saved via callback is shown. the goal is that when i switch tabs, i look to different columns of the same rows, i.e., i'm on the same page:

library(shiny)
shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(tabsetPanel(tabPanel("panel1", dataTableOutput('dt1'),
                                      verbatimTextOutput('infodt1'),
                                      value="p1"),
                             tabPanel("panel2", dataTableOutput('dt2'),
                                      verbatimTextOutput('infodt2'),
                                      value="p2"),
                             id="selpanel")),
  server = function(input, output) { 

    output$dt1 = renderDataTable({ ## how can i show the page at input$page ?
      iris[, 1:2]
    }, callback = 'function(table) {
      table.on("draw", function() {
        Shiny.onInputChange("page", table.page());
      });
    }') 
   
    output$dt2 = renderDataTable({ ## how can i show the page at input$page ?
      iris[, 3:5]
    }, callback = 'function(table) {
      table.on("draw", function() {
        Shiny.onInputChange("page", table.page());
      });
    }')
   
    output$infodt1 = renderPrint({
      input$page
    })
   
    output$infodt2 = renderPrint({
      input$page
    })
  }
)

thanks!!
robert.
